title.narrative: PFM CB for Improved Service Delivery (FMISD) - Multi-annual Programme Estimate

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Public Financial Management Capacity Building Programme for Improved Service Delivery (Financial Management Improvement Programme FMIP IV), is to assist the Government of South Africa in building a capable developmental state in line with the Constitution, National Development Plan, Medium Term Strategic Framework and all relevant PFM legislation and policy, resulting in inclusive growth and socio-economic transformation by 2030. The programme follows on from the Financial Management Improvement Programme (FMIP III) that was implemented over the period 2012-2018. The programme aims to improve government's performance, professionalism and delivery of critical services, especially at local government level, by strengthening PFM capacity and governance to increase access to socio-economic rights and services, enhance the quality of service delivery, obtain greater value for money in public spending, reduce poverty and combat corruption. FMIP IV therefore essentially supports the National Treasurys Chief Directorate: Capacity Development, to implement its 10-year Public Finance Management Capacity Development Strategy, addressing the multitude of PFM challenges facing all three spheres of government but with a particular focus on local government.
